rowText.steps: Open the AI models hub, read the popup's total height, the list area's height, and how many model rows are visible.
rowText.expected: Confirms the ~520px cap and ~90px left for the list (previously measured, not yet fixed).

reads.note: Two installed models (gemma4:e2b-it-qat, qwen3.5:4b) are on the Browse & pull tab; the list's own scroll box is only 114px tall against 216px of row content, so only about two rows show before a person has to scroll.

verdictSentence: The AI models list still only shows about two rows before you have to scroll -- the list's own box is 114px tall while everything above it (header, filters, search box) eats the rest of the roughly 456px popup -- so this is still cramped, not yet fixed.
